north_star: Frontier-level problem solving with minimum necessary computation
hypothesis: The same frozen one source program 'aa18de87', composed with a generic typed MASK-PROJECT and non-destructive MERGE adapter, can solve >=2 new original public ARC TRAIN tasks beyond the frozen classical+P43+P44 correct-set union 55. This changes representation, unlike failed pure D4×S10 symmetry closure, without modifying seed code or adding any second ARC-specific primitive.

provenance.parent_P44_science: SCOPED_ONE_SEED_ORBIT_REUSE_FAIL, only 1 original correct and +0 beyond prior 55

invariant_structure: Source f_seed connects first and last nonzero in each canonical row by filling intervening zero with color 2. New type adapter: for selected axis, background b, marker predicate M ('all non-b' or one particular color m!=b), project raw color grid to Boolean mask 1 if M, else 0; apply frozen f_seed to projected mask; merge ONLY where source input cell==b and f_seed produced 2, writing c!=b. Nonselected colors always retained. This is human-authored typed structural lifting, not a neural-generated new operator.

parametric_family.marker_option_semantics: One ALL_NON_BACKGROUND plus nine equal_to_marker(m), m != b
parametric_family.search_contraction: Infer background b and fill c uniquely from ORIGINAL TRAIN changed pixels (every changed input must share b and changed target must share c); if no changes or inconsistent b/c or shape change, ABSTAIN. Only evaluate 20 marker+axis candidates with inferred b/c. TRAIN-only inference, TEST inputs used for prediction, original TEST outputs read only after source programs finish.

comparison.statistic: new exact original cases outside frozen correct-set OR(P30,P43,P44). Only an oracle union upper bound, not a conflict-safe deployable merger.
comparison.equal_rights_classical: The mask adapter and full 20-candidate exact enumeration are deterministic CLASSICAL. The same expanded representation is offered to GP/CEGIS; no learned-exclusive advantage can be claimed from this study.

initial_gate: SCOPED_ONE_SEED_MASK_LIFT_PASS iff >=2 new original test-exact cases beyond prior 55, zero incorrect accepted programs, and >=1 new correct case with selective marker m (not ALL_NON_BACKGROUND). Otherwise FAIL/STOP.
controls: Frozen seed source Git blob, old three historical first receipts and original ARC commit pinned
Synthetic independent direct graph/line reference checks over arbitrary palette and orientation
Exact TRAIN-only changed-pixel inference; no score-gold or filename as selector
At least one nontrivial changed training cell; guard identity degenerate programs
All consistent candidate TEST outputs must agree, else ABSTAIN
Unknown/candidate exceptions/invalid grids => ABSTAIN; no unsafe output accepted
No mutation of first P44 or original P43 evidence
Alternate independent source audit from immutable P45 first, no learned model rerun
costs: Count candidate execution, CPU and wall, source fetch; teacher original generation and human operator-adapter authoring NOT METERED. No Q4/10x claim.
degraded_mode: Malformed original files, changed source/git blob, incompatible TRAIN deltas, conflicting plausible candidates, runtime error, or unverified result => no prediction / no scientific proof.
